tolerance.reason: BRepOffsetAPI_MakeThickSolid does not return this volume twice. One binary compiled once and run thirty times against the pinned v4.0.0-kernel.3 asset printed seven distinct values, 1698.4365698478466 to 1698.436569847848, a relative spread of 8.2e-16 or a few units in the last place of a double; the transcript's 1698.4365698478475 is the most common of them. It is the only drifting line of this probe: the other four offset volumes and every other line were identical across all thirty runs, so this is the measurement and not the machine. Declared as a tolerance rather than volatile because the volume IS what the record claims: the value stays compared, `done=1 valid=1` and the non-numeric text have to match exactly, and 1e-14 is twelve times the observed spread and two orders below the cap. The cause is #3003 and it is found: BRepOffset_MakeOffset::BuildOffsetByArc hands the roots of its image to the shell builder in the iteration order of a DataMap hashed on TShape addresses, so the faces of the result, and the order the volume is summed in, change between processes. Kernel patch 0047 fixes it and the pinned asset does not carry it yet, so this declaration stays until the repin that pins it, and comes out then with the transcript recaptured (patched value 1698.436569847848). Scripts/repro/3003-offset-roots-hash-order/. #2965.
